photos.file: Large Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake (Crotalus adamanteus) at Smyrna Dunes Park - Flickr - Andrea Westmoreland.jpg
photos.desc: Such a beauty! I wish the light etc. was better but regardless this was a lifer for me. I heard it rumored that a large rattler had been seen at the park so for the past few years I've kept my eye out
Crotalus adamanteus is a kind of diamond rattlesnake. This specimen is in the Universeum Science Park, Gothenburg, Sweden.
February 7th, 2018 High of 75 degrees Fahrenheit Cloudy, windy Irwin County, Georgia
